messages:
maria: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #1834? small change to the py SDK client to expose batching_policy hooks and a couple of config defaults. targeting a Friday deploy, would love approvals by EOD tomorrow if possible. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1834
sam: on it, can you paste the main behavioral change? is this opt-in or changes default batching?
maria: opt-in via client config: `batching_policy=None` by default, can set to `AdaptiveBatching(max_latency_ms=20)` or `FixedBatch(size=8)`. also adds `streaming_toolcall` flag in client to preserve previous streaming behavior. small unit tests added under tests/test_batching.py
ci-bot: CI passed — unit tests 124/124, integration staging skipped (label: requires-staging) :white_check_mark:
noah: quick skim — looks fine but flake reported one long line in tests/test_batching.py: E501. will file a tiny fix suggestion in the PR review UI
arya: i can do a fuller review after stand (in ~1.5h). if no regressions in streaming path that's most important for me. also can you add a short changelog entry under docs/changes.md?
maria: thanks — adding changelog in next push, will address E501. note: backwards compatible, the streaming_toolcall change is a no-op unless `streaming_toolcall=True` is passed
sam: left two nits inline: prefer `max_latency_ms` docstring clarified and a small type hint for `batching_policy` in client/__init__.py
maria: got both, pushed patch `.../sdk@1834-clarify`
ci-bot: running CI for branch 1834-clarify — tests queued
noah: if CI passes i'll approve. also, can we gate the docs change behind a short example snippet showing `AdaptiveBatching` in README? saves follow-ups
maria: will add README snippet now, aiming to merge after approvals and green CI. thanks folks :pray:
arya: cool, will re-review after the README commit. thanks for the heads up :thumbsup:
ci-bot: CI passed for 1834-clarify — all checks green :rocket:
noah: approving now. feel free to merge once you squash the fixup commit, try to keep commits tidy for changelog
maria: merged — thanks everyone! releasing to canary tomorrow morning.
